Component(dsl: 1, id: "test/animate", name: "animate", kind: Kind.section, description: "Golden case",
  
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build: Column(children: [Animate(child: Text(child: "Default")), Animate(effect: Effect.slideUp, duration: 300, delay: 120, curve: Curve.easeOut, distance: 32, child: Text(child: "Up")), Animate(effect: Effect.slideDown, curve: Curve.linear, child: Text(child: "Down")), Animate(effect: Effect.slideLeft, curve: Curve.ease, child: Text(child: "Left")), Animate(effect: Effect.slideRight, curve: Curve.easeIn, child: Text(child: "Right")), Animate(effect: Effect.scale, curve: Curve.easeInOut, child: Text(child: "Scale")), Animate(effect: Effect.pop, curve: Curve.easeOutBack, child: Text(child: "Pop")), ForEach(items: [1, 2, 3], as: "n", indexAs: "i", child: Animate(effect: Effect.fade, delay: i * 60, child: Text(child: "Item ${n}")))]))])
